title: Emphatic Structures with Lo + Adjective/Adverb + Que

sections.content:
When expressing intensity or degree, **lo + adjetivo / adverbio + que** translates to 'how [adjective/adverb] ... is/was!':

• **With adjective** (agrees in gender and number with the noun!):
  *No sabes lo difícil que fue el examen.* (You don't know how difficult the exam was.)
  *Mira lo contentas que están las chicas.* (Look how happy the girls are.)
• **With adverb** (invariable):
  *¡No te imaginas lo rápido que corre!* (You can't imagine how fast he runs!)
  *Me sorprende lo bien que hablas español.* (I'm amazed at how well you speak Spanish.)

sections.title: Rules and Patterns
rows: lo rápido que pasa el tiempo

items.spanish: No te imaginas lo cansada que terminé después de la excursión.
items.english: You can't imagine how tired I ended up after the hike.

items.spanish: Es increíble lo rápido que aprenden los niños pequeños.
items.english: It's incredible how fast young children learn.

items.spanish: Me di cuenta de lo complicado que era resolver el enigma.
items.english: I realized how complicated it was to solve the riddle.

sections.content: Notice that unlike abstract *lo bueno* (always masculine singular), in emphatic *lo + adj + que*, the adjective agrees with the subject: *lo contenta que está Elena*.
